falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A lesson may include an assignment, but the two are not the same thing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 考試不等於一般 assignment exam 是在受控條件下測驗知識或能力；assignment 通常是較自由完成並提交的作業。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An exam assesses performance under test conditions; an assignment is usually completed over a longer period.

falseSynonyms.zh: 測驗不等於作業 test 通常是短時間評量；assignment 是指定工作，可以有研究、寫作或製作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A test measures performance; an assignment asks students to produce or complete work.

falseSynonyms.zh: 教案不等於學生作業 lesson plan 是教師的教學安排，不是學生提交的作業。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A teacher prepares a lesson plan and gives students assignments.

falseSynonyms.zh: 科目不等於作業 subject 是學習領域，如 English 或 Science；assignment 是該科目中的一項工作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON English is a subject; an essay may be an English assignment.

falseSynonyms.zh: 課程不等於作業 course 是一整套學習單元；assignment 是其中一項要求。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A course may contain several assignments.

falseSynonyms.zh: 筆記不等於作業 notes 是學習記錄或資料；除非老師明確要求提交筆記，否則不等於 assignment。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Notes can help with an assignment, but they are not usually the assignment itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 活動過於寬泛 activity 可以是任何課堂或學習活動；assignment 通常有明確完成要求和成果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A classroom activity may not require submission, while an assignment usually has a defined outcome.
